description: R08 Functional Closeout checkpoint: retire the complete residual TerminalBuffer wrapping and URL-pattern family after green Rust CI and Quality Census on the published product/witness HEAD.

entries.notes: Rust reuses the buffer Last Column Flag owner and records the consumed delayed wrap so Microsoft's 100 printable-character vector lands at cursor (20,1), preserves exact text, and marks row 0 forced-wrap only.
Rust feeds Microsoft's exact Test100CharsString through the same autowrap owner and reproduces cursor, row-wrap flags, and buffer content.
Rust detects plain-text URL intervals in single rows, across forced-wrap rows, after scrollback movement, and projects stable buffer coordinates back to viewport-relative intervals.
